events.text:
I created the LinkedIn campaign in Tantra as a draft and read it back. T-058 is blocked again, now assigned to Bhaskar, waiting on members connecting their LinkedIn.

**Completion check:**
1. **Who holds the LinkedIn slots: done.** The account list (read-only) shows 0 LinkedIn accounts in the GrowthClub workspace. The only account connected is one WhatsApp number, which the WhatsApp reminders use. So 1 of the 2 Pro slots is free and nobody is marked connected.
   - The earlier "2 of 2 slots in use" came from the test account's workspace, not this one.
   - I named wave 1 as Bhaskar plus Vaibhavi, because Vaibhavi already posts on LinkedIn for the workshop funnels.
   - The only slot Bhaskar could free is the WhatsApp one, which would stop the reminders. So the kit says to keep it and wait for Bharath on a third slot. I removed nothing.
   - This is recorded in `launch-kit.md` 3b and in `ops/outreach.json`.
2. **First lines on the 'Workshop cold calendar' list: done.** None of the 126 contacts has a first line, so I added a fallback opening built from first name and company in kit 3c. None of them has a LinkedIn profile URL either. That can stop the steps from reaching anyone, so 3d asks Bhaskar to check the campaign preview before starting.
3. **Draft campaign: done.** "Workshop LinkedIn: wave 1" (id `6acc47385f16ab824d7d8132`) read back as draft, with 3 LinkedIn steps, no sender and never started.
   - Tantra doesn't take daily caps on a campaign, only on a connected LinkedIn account. So 20 to 25 connects/day and 75 messages/day go on Bhaskar's account once it's connected (kit 3d).
   - The draft is logged in `REVERT_LEDGER.md`.
4. **"Asked of Adi": done, with one difference.** The text now went to a team note to Bhaskar and Bharath. The field itself isn't empty, because a blocked task has to say who it is waiting on. It now holds Bhaskar's connect step and ends "Nothing is asked of Adi."
5. **Assignee and status: done.** T-058 is assigned to Bhaskar, blocked on the member connects, with reviewers Bhaskar and Bharath. F-06b8e775 is acked.

The work is committed as `030b24f6`. Not done, and outside this run: no member is connected and the campaign isn't started. Bhaskar connects at https://usetantra.com/connectors/channels/linkedin, and Bharath still has to answer whether a third slot is free of charge.

To review, open `workshop-plan/outreach/launch-kit.md` (sections 3b to 3d) and `workshop-plan/ops/t058_linkedin_draft.py`.
